g.text: Turn-3 movement toward each branch’s direction; n = valid replies (out of up to 40 planned trials per cell).
Top six rows: proprietary; bottom three: open-weight. All use the same 0–100% color scale.
Unavailable directions and invalid responses are excluded; intelligence-only movement is not expressed-preference adoption.
